title: Andha 7 Naatkal
desc: When Vasanthi's husband, Dr Anand, learns that she was forcefully married to him, he decides to reunite her with her lover. However, Vasanthi soon falls for him and accepts him as her husband.

title: Neethiyin Marupakkam
desc: A carefree young man pays a heavy price for falling in love with a landlord's daughter after unknown assailants kill his family. Eventually, he decides to confront the landlord and seek his revenge.

title: Cheran Pandian
desc: Periya Gounder, bound by caste pride, mistreats his stepbrother Chinna. However, when his daughter falls for Chinna's relative, his beliefs are challenged.

title: Appu
desc: After falling in love with Suchitra, Appu must go against the odds to win her over and marry her despite her father's disapproval of him.

title: Samsaram Adhu Minsaram
desc: A dutiful father, Ammaiyappan Mudaliar, does not leave any wish unfulfilled of his four kids. But soon, his eldest son causes disruption and discontent within the family.
